connectionId.description: Connection to send the invitation on. When absent, the agent creates a standalone invitation and returns it.

did.description: DID of the service the peer is invited to connect to (referral). Requires `connectionId`. When absent, the invitation is for a connection to this agent.

reusable.description: Accept the standalone invitation any number of times, until the record is deleted. Requires that `connectionId` is absent.

label.description: Text the peer shows for a sub-connection invitation or a referral. On a v2 connection it travels as the `description` of the share-media message and as the `metadata.title` of its item. Sub-connection default: the `name` of the ECS-Service credential of the agent, omitted when it holds none. Ignored for a standalone invitation.

imageUrl.description: URL of an image the peer shows for a sub-connection invitation or a referral. On a v2 connection it travels as the `metadata.icon` of the item of the share-media message. Ignored for a standalone invitation.

useLegacyDid.description: Advertise the legacy did:web form when the DID of the agent is did:webvh. Ignored when `connectionId` is present.

didcommVersion.description: DIDComm envelope version of a standalone invitation. Defaults to 'v2'. Ignored when `connectionId` is present.
